title: Tile acceptance decision flow and snippet sandbox
content:
Purpose:
Quick, pragmatic decision flow and a sandbox of tile/headline/description variants for partner listing acceptance. Use this during intake + preflight to reduce round-trips with partners and engineering. Not a final style guide — think of it as a compact toolkit to move listings from intake -> smoke -> go-live.

Scope / audience:
- Audience: GTM listing owners, partner PMs, solutions engineers, platform ops.
- Scope: public marketplace tiles (hero tile + short description), trial entitlements mapping, minimal technical acceptance gates, rollback cues.

Top-line decision flow (1-page checklist you can run in a 10–15 minute sync):
1) Partner Intake sanity (PM/partner):
   - Do we have partner contact + owning solutions engineer? (Y/N)
   - Is there an approved legal/contract flag for trial entitlements? (Y/N)
   - Is product compatible with our runtime constraints (e.g., external connectors, private deployment blockers)? (Y/N)
   -> If any N, block until clarified; put into "intake-blocked" with owner.
2) Copy & positioning (GTM):
   - Select headline variant (A/B) for initial tile (see samples below).
   - Short description <= 220 characters, call out SKUs/trial if relevant.
   - Confirm partner-provided logo (svg/png) and allowed wording.
   -> If partner-provided claims require legal review, tag Legal.
3) Technical acceptance (SE/Platform):
   - Confirm API/contract: does partner require customer-managed keys / on-prem that we cannot support in hosted tile? (Y/N)
   - Check entitlements: trial seat count, timebox, quota limits. Map to SKU id.
   - Verify telemetry hooks: does listing require telemetry beyond standard? (Y/N)
   -> If custom telemetry or incompatible auth, schedule a tech-handoff.
4) Smoke test (Ops QA):
   - Provision a trial SKU and verify signup flow end-to-end (provision -> first API call -> success).
   - Verify tile rendering in marketplace (mobile and desktop snapshots).
   - Validate billing hooks: trial -> conversion transition.
   -> If failure, escalate to SE -> Platform.
5) Go / rollback triggers:
   - Go: smoke tests pass, partner sign-off on copy, legal green.
   - Rollback triggers: billing failures, spike in errors > 5% in first 24h, incorrect claims flagged by partner/legal.
   - Post-go: 72h monitoring window for latency/error pattern; revert tile if critical.

Minimal acceptance checklist (copy this into intake ticket):
- [ ] Partner contact and SE assigned
- [ ] Logo in SVG or 1:1 PNG provided (min 240x240)
- [ ] Short headline (<= 60 chars) – approved by partner
- [ ] Short description (<= 220 chars) – approved by partner
- [ ] Trial entitlements documented and mapped to SKU
- [ ] Billing & metering acceptance criteria documented
- [ ] Tech compatibility confirmed (hosted/dedicated/private)
- [ ] Privacy/claims reviewed (legal)
- [ ] Smoke test plan and owner named

Tile copy sandbox — headlines (pick 1, keep short):
- Headline A: "Redwood-Optimized LLM Inference for [Partner]"
- Headline B: "Scale [Partner]’s AI features with low-latency inference"
- Headline C: "Bring fast, reliable LLM serving to [company/team]"
- Headline D (developer focus): "API-first inference with predictable costs"

Short description variants (220-char max):
1) "Deploy [Partner] with Redwood’s inference runtime. Low-latency generation, prefix caching, and flexible deployment (hosted, dedicated, private). Includes 14-day trial and per-token billing."
2) "Ship LLM features fast: managed endpoints, model rollouts, and observability for production workloads. Free trial includes developer credits and 100k tokens."
3) "Reduce inference cost and latency with workload-aware batching and model suggestions. Enterprise plans include dedicated pools and SLA-backed latency targets."

Microcopy snippets for feature bullets (use 1–3):
- "Streaming responses & tool-calling ready"
- "Model catalog with performance profiles"
- "Token-level cost breakdown in Console"
- "Dedicated GPU pools with autoscale"

Trial entitlements + SKU mapping (example lines to paste into intake):
- Trial SKU: TRL-STD-30D -> 14 days, 100k token credit, 1 dev seat (no enterprise features)
- Trial SKU: TRL-ENT-14D -> 14 days, 200k token credit, 3 seats, access to Dedicated eval
- Conversion SKU: PS-A-ONDEMAND -> per-token pricing, metering enabled
Note: map partner trial request to nearest SKU; if custom entitlements required, flag Legal + Billing.

Technical acceptance quick checks (SE checklist):
- API contract endpoint documented and reachable from our smoke environment
- Auth type supported (API key / OAuth / SSO) — list exact flow
- No restricted IP ranges or on-prem-only dependencies for hosted trials
- Minimal required telemetry: request_id, model_id, latency_ms, error_code
- Fallback policy for overloaded regions defined (route -> alternate model or deny)

Smoke test script (ops):
1) Create trial instance with TRL-STD-30D in staging account
2) Run 10 representative generation calls with typical prompts (short/long)
3) Verify responses complete within expected latency band (e.g., p95 < 600ms for these prompts)
4) Confirm billing events emitted for token usage (sample event consumed by metering pipeline)
5) Snapshot tile rendering in app (desktop, mobile) and attach to ticket

Rollback playbook (short):
- Immediate rollback if billing hook fails to record conversion (customer impact)
- Immediate rollback if smoke tests show production pattern regressions (errors > 5%)
- Notify partner success, SE, and Legal via dedicated thread; include runbook steps and who to reroute to

Notes to self / open questions (team use):
- Do we want a single canonical trial SKU for "marketplace discoverability" or tiered trials depending on partner size? pros/cons listed in comments below.
- How strict should we be on headline claims that imply "SLA" vs: "Designed for latency-sensitive apps"? Legal guidance needed.
- Consider adding a one-click test-in-prod preview for partners in Console (explore in Q1 roadmap).

Sample intake ticket template (paste into Jira/Linear):
Title: Marketplace listing — [Partner Name] — tile + trial intake
Description:
- Partner contact: [name, email]
- SE owner: [name]
- Proposed headline: [pick one]
- Proposed short description: [paste variant or custom]
- Trial SKU requested: [TRL-XXX]
- Tech notes: [auth, endpoints, special requirements]
- Assets: [logo url, screenshots]
- Linked legal concern: [yes/no] (if yes, tag Legal)

Owner notes / next steps (for first stab):
- SE to confirm endpoints and trial mapping within 48h
- GTM to run partner through microcopy variants and return approvals within 72h
- Ops to schedule smoke test slot in next 3 business days after SE confirmation

Versioning / history (for doc hygiene):
- v0.1 (2024-12-03) initial working sketch — Priya
- v0.2 (2025-01-12) added trial SKU examples + smoke script — Priya/Marco

End of doc.
